{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Boombox''' was a tanky enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had decent health and below average speed. It also had 25% [[Defense]], reducing damage taken by 20%. ==Appearance== The '''Boombox''' is a black boombox with blue screen and white adjustment dials. It has black arms with white gloves and black legs with shoes. On one of the screens, it has "''ADIDAS''" written on it. The logos of the company are also present on the speakers. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]] are also capable of bypassing its [[Defense]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} BoomboxCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} BoomboxIconIG.png|'''Boombox''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Boombox''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Boombox''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Boombox's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. **{{Bug}} '''Boombox''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Boombox''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Soccer Ball]] & [[Cleats]]|Wave 1|Boombox|Wave 3|[[Whistle]]|Wave 4}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Soccer Ball]] & [[Cleats]]|Wave 1|Boombox|Wave 3|[[Whistle]]|Wave 5}} {{VictoryField|[[Cleats]]|Wave 2 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Soccer Ball]] & [[Cleats]]|hardw1 = Wave 1 (Hard)|[[Boombox]]|Wave 3|[[Whistle]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
